name: print-social-eduaction-back-to-school-flyer-orange-purple-quadrant
title: 'Your Children's Education Is Our Priority' flyer split into orange, purple and pink quadrants with an atom badge
whatItMeans: Bold and organised; splitting the flyer into flat colour quadrants keeps a lot of school-related content easy to scan at a glance.
whatItIs: A square flyer divided into four quadrants (cream, lavender, orange, pink) with a bold black headline 'Your Children's Education Is Our Priority', a yellow paper-plane badge, an 'X' motif box, a black wavy 'Back to School' tag, a scalloped atom-icon seal, colour-coded text bars and a pencil illustration.
techniques: Split a layout into distinct flat-colour quadrants.
Use a scalloped seal badge for a trust or credential mark.
Mix bar-style filler graphics with real body copy for texture.

vocabulary.definition: A design split into four distinct colour sections.
A badge shape with a wavy, stamp-like edge.
